description:
Workflow for Spliced RNAseq data
**Steps:**

* workflow_quality.cwl:
	* FastQC (Read Quality Control)
	* fastp (Read Trimming)
* STAR (Read mapping)
* featurecounts (transcript read counts)
* kallisto (transcript [pseudo]counts)
name: Spliced RNAseq workflow
tools: calculates gene counts with bowtie2 mapped data and input gtf file with featurecounts.
preparation of featurecounts output files to a specific output folder
preparation of kallisto output files to a specific output folder
preparation of star output files to a specific output folder
quality assessment of illumina reads with rrna filtering option
runs star alignment on the genome with the quality filtered reads.
